title: The theory-to-practice loop
caption: Theory guides action, and feedback corrects theory. The loop protects against rigid labels.

title: Three parts of alliance
caption: A working alliance needs trust, shared aims, agreed activities, and repair when strain appears.

title: From surface behavior to hidden meaning
caption: Psychodynamic work moves from what is seen to what may be meant, always as a hypothesis.

title: The attachment cycle
caption: Repeated cycles shape internal working models. Therapy can offer a new cycle.

title: Belonging strategies
caption: Adlerian and interpersonal lenses ask what strategy a child uses to secure a place.

title: Protective moves under anxiety
caption: Horney's protective moves can become costly when they are the only options available.

title: Persona and shadow
caption: Jungian work explores what is excluded from the social mask without forcing symbols.

title: Core conditions for growth
caption: Person-centered therapy treats the relationship conditions as central, not decorative.

title: Existential concerns
caption: Existential therapy helps clients face the conditions of living rather than only remove symptoms.

title: The behavior chain
caption: Functional assessment asks what maintains a behavior before choosing an intervention.

title: The cognitive cycle
caption: CBT tests meanings and actions so that new evidence can update the cycle.

title: Sources of self-efficacy
caption: Self-efficacy grows through experience, observation, credible support, and reinterpretation of arousal.

title: Psychological flexibility
caption: ACT targets the relationship to experience rather than only the content of thoughts.

title: Awareness experiment
caption: Experiential work uses present-moment experiments to expand awareness and choice.

title: From problem story to preferred story
caption: Narrative and solution-focused work builds alternative stories from existing strengths.

title: Adapting theory to development
caption: Child counseling translates theory into the child's developmental language and daily systems.

title: Cultural formulation questions
caption: Culture is not an add-on. It shapes how distress is understood and help is sought.

title: The four P's formulation
caption: A testable formulation links history, triggers, maintenance, and strengths to a plan.

title: Choosing an integrative plan
caption: Integration is a reasoned sequence, not a random mixture of techniques.

title: The scholar-practitioner container
caption: Doctoral practice is held by ethics, supervision, and evidence, not by theory alone.
